notes: City of Frisco, TX: the whole city within city limits, across Collin County (113 km2) and Denton County (66 km2). Built by data/jurisidictions/run_frisco.py (collin_county.py + denton_county.py, shared runner tx_multicounty.py). 67,438 parcels, $19.98B land (Collin $12.45B, Denton $7.53B). All values 2026.

Collin County: Collin Central Appraisal District's own public parcel layer (CCAD Parcel Feature Set, data of 2026-10-23); the layer has rolled to the 2027 roll year, so the 2026 certified values are its prior-year fields. Properties split for 2027 are re-joined with their child polygons, so each 2026 value sits on the land it was appraised for.

Denton County: Denton Central Appraisal District's 2026 certified export (PACS 8.0.33, 2026-07-27) joined on prop_id to its certified parcel polygons (Parcels_Certified_2026, nightly geodatabase); both downloaded by hand. Undrawn condo units are placed on their parcel via Denton CAD's condo link table or a matching legal description.

Check: the districts' taxable land on City of Frisco properties is $12.494B (Collin, CFR) and $7.606B (Denton, C32) vs $12.452B and $7.530B kept; the Denton gap is mostly records Denton CAD's map does not draw.
City limits: Census TIGER/Line 2025 place 4827684; the counties' Frisco codes agree on all but 12 / 6 accounts.

Exempt land dropped: total exemption codes / EX flags plus named public owners: 1,656 records. Condos: 957 units in 51 developments merged onto their land; 863 leftover nominal common areas (914 ac) dropped like exempt land.
Singularity sweep: 10 of 67,438 parcels, all at most 4.3x the neighbourhood or hidden slivers.
Under 100k parcels: browser GeoParquet path, no PMTiles bake.

Parking is OSM delivered through Overture Maps (release 2026-10-21.0, --overture-only), classified surface vs structure: 427 lots, 566.0 acres, $389M est. land value. apply_parking_category.py tagged 19 parcels 'Parking Lot'.

Links: Collin parcels open Collin CAD's eSearch page pinned to 2026 (esearch.collincad.org/Property/View/<prop_id>?year=2026; confirmed); Denton parcels Denton CAD's property page (denton.prodigycad.com/property-detail/<prop_id>/2026).
